advisories: Optional (serialization contract): keep per-overlap ESD diagnostics in the separate work_dir/misreg/esd_overlap_diagnostics.json exactly as designed and never move them into arcs.json rows. The existing loader _load_arcs (faninsar/stack/session.py:4675) constructs MisregArc(**row), which raises on unknown keys, so any extra field added to arc rows would break arc loading for all existing caches. The proposed split preserves that contract; treat it as binding during implementation.

Optional (integrity hardening): the force_esd_azimuth_shift_px seam currently converts task kwargs with float(...) only (faninsar/missions/s1/processing.py:680-684). When injecting the overlap aggregate, reject non-finite values (NaN/inf) at the injection site so a degenerate overlap cannot silently poison the resample; a one-line finite check at the seam suffices. Not required for the MVP acceptance conditions.

Optional (config validation): validate esd_coherence_threshold (finite, within [0, 1]) and the multilook tuple (positive ints) at StackConfig validation time so a malformed runconfig fails at load instead of yielding a silently empty qualifying set. Robustness only; the design already fails closed on QC-empty results.

Optional (data minimization): keep the diagnostics JSON to numeric and geometry metadata only (indices, coherence, response ratios) and avoid absolute host paths or usernames, since scratch work-dirs in this domain are commonly shared between collaborators. Light-touch minimization consistent with the local trust model; not a boundary change.
